_meta.purpose: Frozen per-game facts captured from CURRENT, UNMODIFIED game code BEFORE any revamp edit. These are the byte-stable contract values the revamp must preserve.

fields.gameName: Exact string passed to DodoAnalytics.gameStart/gameOver — MUST stay byte-identical after revamp (GA4 contract).
fields.analytics: The exact game_name argument found at each analytics call site (gameStart/gameOver). null = call site absent.
fields.legacyKeys: Every localStorage key the current game reads/writes. These migrate one-time into dodo_{slug}_highscore via DodoJuice.highscore(slug, legacyKeys). [] = game has NO persistence today (a known bug the revamp fixes).
fields.startSelector: DOM selector of the control that begins gameplay in index.html. null = game auto-starts on load OR starts via keyboard/tap (see startVia).
fields.restartSelector: DOM selector that restarts after game-over (best-effort; null = unknown/reuses start, game task confirms).
fields.newHighscoreKey: The standardized key the revamp will persist under: dodo_{slug}_highscore.
fields.dpiCheck: Whether assertion #10 (DPI-aware canvas) applies — true only when core gameplay renders on a canvas.
fields.notes: Anything the game task must know (missing analytics, broken persistence, Tailwind CDN, structure, etc.).

ddos-defense-dodo.notes: Legacy key 'dodo_highscore' is dangerously generic (collides across games) — migration to slug key is important.

payment-invaders-dodo.notes: Uses cdn.tailwindcss.com (must be removed by revamp). Canvas not DPI-aware today.

snake-game-dodo.notes: KNOWN BUG: no localStorage persistence at all (high score never saved). No legacy key to migrate. Uses cdn.tailwindcss.com.

checkout-rush-dodo.notes: KNOWN BUG: zero persistence (no localStorage). Uses cdn.tailwindcss.com. Has a <canvas> but core gameplay is DOM payment-type buttons (#btn-card/#btn-crypto/#btn-qr) — DPI check not applicable to gameplay.

dodo-dash.notes: No start button — gameplay begins on SPACE/UP keypress or canvas tap (#gameCanvas). Restart via SPACE/tap on game-over. Canvas hardcoded 800x300 (not responsive), keyboard-only today. Pattern-B structure (assets at game root) to be standardized in Task 0.5.

merchant-hero-dodo.notes: Keyboard-only today. Pattern-B structure (assets at game root) to be standardized in Task 0.5. Legacy key camelCase 'dodoHighscore'.

api-wordle-dodo.notes: No start button — the guess board is interactive immediately on load. 'gameStart' fires on first interaction/load. legacyKey is a JSON stats object (dodo_wordle_stats: {games,wins}), not a numeric highscore — migration must preserve the object.

dodo-pong.notes: Pilot game. Canvas not DPI-aware today; zero audio; zero CSS animation. Score element #playerScore.

ledger-blocks-dodo.notes: Tetris — solid logic, zero CSS animation today.

revenue-2048-dodo.notes: DOM grid (stays DOM). Second proof game. Score element #score. Legacy key stored via STORAGE_KEY const = 'dodo_revenue_2048_highscore'.

token-match-dodo.notes: DOM memory match (stays DOM). Shallowest game — biggest redesign planned.
